keyset.title: Keyset
keyset.profile_new_tip: Ka samee profile laga soo koobiyay waxyaalaha hadda jira
keyset.compare_hint: Dooro kala duwanaanshaha si aad uga koobiyeeyso isha una gal profile firfircoon. Ficilada ka maqan isha lama koobiyn karo
keyset.compare_missing_source_hint: Ficilkani ma laha ilo xidhidh mana la koobi karayn karo.
keyset.compare_changed: Faylalkii waa la beddelay. Dib u eeg kala duwanaanshaha la cusboonaysiiyay ka hor intaadan codsan.
keyset.search_syntax_tip: Isticmaal #category, @mod, $key ama {wax beddelka}. Xigasho magacyo leh boosas, tusaale ahaan @"Meelaynta Saxda ah ee xannibaadda". Ku dar filtarrada leh magacyo ficil.
keyset.keyboard_hint: Dooro fal markaas taabo furaha ama jiirka
keyset.no_bindings: Ma jiraan wax xidhid ah oo u dhigma filtarradan.
keyset.capture_binding_tip: guji oo taabo furaha ama badhanka jiirka
keyset.virtual_key_tip: guji si aad u shaandhayso %s; markaad qabsanayso, u qoondee galintan
keyset.capture_prompt: Adeecida %s · Baxsashadu waxay tirtirtaa xidhidhkii oo dhan
keyset.reset_all_prompt: Dhammaan xidhidhiyeyaasha waxay ku noqon doonaan khaladaadkoodii.
keyset.error_generic: Wuxuuna ilaalin kari waayay badalkan. Hubi qoraalka oo isku day mar kale.
keyset.error.shared_conflict: Dejinta ayaa lagu beddelay tusaale kale oo Minecraft ah. Dib u eeg qiyamka la cusboonaysiiyay oo isku day mar kale.
keyset.error.shared_sync: Ma soo celin karo goobaha la wadaago. Xirmooyinkaaga hadda waa la hayaa
keyset.error.recovered: Waxaa laga soo celiyay profile burburay.
keyset.error.storage: Lama akhriyin lamana qori karin kaydinta xogta. Hubi buugga ciyaarta
keyset.conflict_peers: Falalka kale ee ku saabsan amarkan: %s
keyset.conflict_replace_tip: Ka fur dhammaan waxyaalaha kale ee iska hor imaanaya
keyset.conflict_swap_tip: U guuri falka kale kii hore ee falkan ahaa: %s
keyset.conflict_swap_unavailable: Waa la heli ka dib u yeelaan furaha khilaafsan camal kale
keyset.conflict_gone: Dhulkaas waa la xaliyay ama waa la bedelay.
keyset.conflict_changed: Xidhmada waxaa lagu beddelay daaqad kale. Dib u eeg khilaafka mar kale.
keyset.undo_done: Hadalkii u dambeeyay waa la tuuray
keyset.auto_profile_requires_world: Ku biir adduun ama server si aad u samaysato muuqaal toos ah
keyset.auto_profile_remove_tip: Ka saar astaanta tooska ah ee %s
keyset.auto_profile_removed: Boor si toos ah ayaa looga saaray %2$s (%1$s)
keyset.listening: Adeecida · ESC si ay u furto
keyset.native_hint: MaLib hotkey · riix isku darka, ka dibna sii daaya furayaasha
keyset.native_capture_prompt: Riix isku dar ah, ka dibna sii daaya · Baxsada
keyset.transfer_import_prompt: Ka soo rar profiles %s faylka JSON ee gal wadaaga wareejinta Keyset? Muuqaallo isku mid ah waa laga boodi doonaa
keyset.transfer_exported: Faylka waxaa loo dhoofiyay galka wareejinta Keyset-ka la wadaago. Dhismayaasha kale ee Minecraft ayaa geli kara.
keyset.transfer_duplicate: Wax cusub ma jiro. Muuqaalladani waa horeba u jireen.
keyset.transfer_empty: Meel bogga la dhoofiyay ee JSON faylalka galka wareejinta Keyset la wadaago marka hore.
keyset.appearance_invalid_hex: Gali lix lambar oo hexadesimal ah
keyset.visibility_hint: Qari ama soo celi hababka iyo qaybaha adoon bedelin furayaasha kulul
keyset.visibility_hint_count: Qaybaha qarsoon: %s. Furayaasha kulul ayaa weli firfircoon; khilaafyada weli waxaa ka mid ah falalka qarsoon.
keyset.visibility_hide_section: Hide this section: collapse it and remove its highlights from the keyboard. Hotkeys will keep working.
keyset.visibility_hidden_notice: Section hidden: %1$s. Its hotkeys still work in game.
keyset.visibility_hide_tip: Ka qari tifaftiraha. furayaasha kulul ayaa firfircoonaada
keyset.visibility_search_syntax_tip: Isticmaal #category ama @mod si aad u bedesho oo aad u raadiso liiska. Ku dheji magacyo meelo bannaan oo xigashooyin ah.
keyset.profile_scope_detach_tip: U isticmaal profiles gaar ah tusaale ahaan. profiles-yadaada waxa la koobiyeeyay isticmaalka kowaad; profile-yada deegaanka ee jira waa la soo celiyay. Boggaga la wadaago waa la heli karaa
keyset.profile_scope_attach_tip: Dib ugu xidh profile-yada la wadaago adoon ku biirin. Xogahaaga gaarka ah ayaa loo hayaa hadhow.
keyset.profile_scope_attached: Muraayadaha la wadaago waa la dajiyay
keyset.profile_scope_detached: Muuqaal gaar ah ayaa loo oggolaaday tusaale ahaan
keyset.themes_empty: Save your current colors as a theme.
keyset.themes_exported: Theme exported to %s and copied to the clipboard.
keyset.themes_import_hint: Import theme JSON from the clipboard, or place a theme file in %s.
keyset.themes_no_import: No theme JSON found in the clipboard or transfer folder.
keyset.preview_scroll_hint: Drag the bar to view the rest of the keyboard
keyset.legend_fn_hint: Fn is controlled by the keyboard hardware. It is shown for reference and cannot be bound separately.
keyset.keyboard_fn_hint: Fn is controlled by the keyboard hardware. It is shown for reference and cannot be bound separately.
keyset.appearance_mouse_body_hint: Color of the top and side mouse shell. Button colors follow their binding state.
keyset.bottom_hint: Select a key, then move it left or right.
keyset.bottom_fit_hint: Other key widths adjust to fit. Click the width to restore Auto.
keyset.section_hidden_tip: This section is hidden. Use + to restore it. Its hotkeys still work in game.
keyset.section_unbind_prompt: Are you sure you want to unbind all keys in "%1$s"? This will clear bindings for all %2$s actions in the current profile, including actions outside the current search. You can undo this change.
keyset.section_unbind_title: Unbind all keys in this section?
keyset.themes_copy_hint: Copy this resource-pack theme to your saved themes to edit it independently.
keyset.themes_copied: Theme copied to your saved themes.
